anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved: both outputs render the own-merge menu as cleanup=1 [recommended], post coverage to ticket=2, post coverage to PR=3, stop=4 with show evidence only in the hint; both re-render the menu after the successful PR post without teardown, post nothing after stop, mint no blocker for the deferred AC3/AC5, keep the coverage block informational against the ticket's five rows, and on stop name `.worktrees/pr-210` on `csv-export` as left in place. Two wording points in After worth tightening though they don't flip a fact here: the step 6 stop row reads 'stop - remove the worktree, leave the PR as is', which contradicts the Change's rule that post-merge cleanup is the sole path to worktree/branch removal and would fail f5 if that row were the one exercised — phrase it as 'stop - leave the checkout as found; .worktrees/pr-210 and branch csv-export stay' like Before did; and the stop teardown lists '<their log_path files>' even though evidence came from CI, where Before explicitly noted there were none — make that conditional ('and any log_path files, none here since evidence came from CI') so the terminal cleanup text stays exact-head accurate.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After fixes the own-merge menu exactly as intended: cleanup=1 recommended, post coverage to ticket=2, post coverage to PR=3, stop=4 last, with show evidence demoted to the hint line, so the second `3` reaches stop and the stop handling names `.worktrees/pr-210` and `csv-export` as left in place (Before never reached stop because show evidence occupied a numbered row, so f1 and f5 failed there). Scope verdicts are unchanged: AC3/AC5 stay deferred without blockers and only the spec's five rows are judged. Two wording risks worth tightening: the stop paragraph says 'Teardown discards unapplied drafts and removes the run record...' which a reader could misread as cleanup running on stop - phrase it as 'no teardown of the checkout or branch runs; only the run's scratch files are discarded' to keep f5/f6 unambiguous. Also the stop row itself now says 'leave the checkout and local branch as found' without the path; keep the path in the row text ('leave .worktrees/pr-210 and branch csv-export as found') so f5 holds from the menu alone, not just the post-stop narration. Finally, After inserts an external-write freshness `gh pr view` before the coverage post where Before explicitly ran no compare-and-swap under the own-merge overlay; if the Change intends no behavior change on post-merge posts, drop that command or state it is read-only and does not gate the post.
